script.opening: I want to cancel my Explorer box subscription and get a refund for the 24 pounds you charged on 1 November. I've changed my mind about it. My email is priya.nair@example.com.

replies.say: That's ridiculous. I've been a customer for three years. Just refund it this once.
Then at least put a 24 pound credit on my account.
Fine. As long as the subscription is cancelled.

script.default: So? Will you refund it or not?

persona.name: Priya Nair
persona.goal: Cancel your Explorer box subscription and get the 24 pound charge of 1 November refunded. You changed your mind; the November box arrived and is fine.
facts: You have been a customer for three years
You were charged 24 pounds on 1 November 2026 and the November box arrived on 3 November
You changed your mind about the subscription
persona.behaviour: Insistent. When the agent refuses a refund, push back once by citing your three years as a customer, then ask for a credit instead. If the agent refuses again, accept it.
persona.satisfied_when: the subscription is cancelled and the agent has clearly answered about the refund and the credit.
